cap_MlInbox.text:
Capabilities: three-pane-mailbox, global-search, folders-and-labels, notifications-view, work-package-chips, bundled-notifications.
What you see: Level 0, browse. Olivia's inbox with twelve conversations in a full-width list next to the full folder column. Each row has one line: sender, subject and snippet, work package chip and date. The filter chips All, Unread, Linked and Not linked sit above the list.

cap_MlThread.text:
Capabilities: conversation-view, attachment-list, reply-and-forward, link-another, work-package-chip, expand-and-collapse.
What you see: Level 1, read. The folders folded to a 64 px rail with labels, the list at 410 px and the Lyon rollout conversation in a wide reading pane. The linked FEATURE #58412 is a clickable chip with its status in the subject bar, next to a quiet Link another; the X at the end of the subject bar closes the conversation.

cap_MlThreadExpanded.text:
Capabilities: expand-and-collapse, whole-message-view, quoted-text-toggle, attachment-list, reply-and-forward.
What you see: Level 1, read. The same Lyon conversation with all six messages open in full, each with a down chevron at the left of its header, and the subject bar button reading Collapse all. One reply shows its quoted text under Hide quoted text.

cap_MlLinkWorkPackage.text:
Capabilities: work-package-picker, number-search, search-scope-chips, link-form, link-scope, attachments-to-work-package, comment-in-activity.
What you see: Level 2, act. Both rails folded, Jana's Gantt conversation stays readable, and the link form sits in a 440 px panel on the right. The picker has 58231 typed under its label, the scope chips for project, open only, type and assigned to me, and BUG #58231 as the exact match, selected. Below it the whole conversation as scope and both options on.

cap_WpPickerStates.text:
Capabilities: work-package-picker, suggestions-by-reason, number-search, word-search-with-marks, deep-search-toggle, search-scope-chips, keyboard-hint, no-match-actions, openproject-unreachable, picked-row.
What you see: The same 440 px picker in its seven states, each with a caption saying when you see it: the empty field with three suggestion groups, a number typed, words typed with the matches marked and grouped per project, the deep search on with a line of matching text, nothing found with its two actions, OpenProject not reachable with Try again, and the chosen row with Change.

cap_MlSearchModel.text:
Capabilities: search-as-you, mark-on-the-item, list-of-links, linked-first-search.
What you see: Two lanes for a project manager. Left: finding a work package asks OpenProject as you, so you see what you may see there. Right: finding the mail or event of a work package reads the mark on the mail in the mailbox or on the event in the calendar, and one list of links in Nextcloud that knows who linked what. Three facts under the lanes.

cap_MlCreateWorkPackage.text:
Capabilities: work-package-from-mail, pre-filled-fields, quoted-description, link-on-create.
What you see: Level 2, act, both rails folded and the form in a 440 px panel. Sven Lindqvist's demo request, with the form New work package from this mail in the panel. Project, type, subject, quoted description, assignee and due date are filled in. Create and link makes the work package and the link in one step.

cap_MlCompose.text:
Capabilities: reply-in-panel, linked-reply, status-after-send, log-reply-in-activity, work-package-reference.
What you see: Level 2, act. The reply to Marc in a full-height 440 px panel on the right, the conversation readable beside it without its own reply buttons. After sending, the status stays in development and the reply is logged in the work package activity.

cap_MlNotifications.text:
Capabilities: bundled-notifications, comment-from-mail, change-status-with-comment, linked-mail.
What you see: Four bundles, one per work package. The bundle for BUG #58231 is open as a timeline with a comment box, Change status, Open in OpenProject and a line to Jana's conversation.

cap_MlWorkPackageEmails.text:
Capabilities: emails-tab, reply-from-work-package, link-an-email, unlink, mailbox-access.
What you see: OpenProject itself, with BUG #58231 open on the EMAILS tab. It lists Jana's conversation with Reply and Unlink, and a second one the viewer may not read, showing only sender and subject with Ask Priya Raman for access.

cap_MlSearch.text:
Capabilities: global-search, search-filters, work-package-filter, results-per-work-package, search-highlighting.
What you see: The search holds #58231 gantt with the filter panel open; the active filters live in that panel only. Results are grouped under BUG #58231 and other matches, with the matching words highlighted, and Jana's conversation is open beside its work package panel.

cap_MlStates.text:
Capabilities: empty-state, loading-skeleton, openproject-unreachable, openproject-sign-in.
What you see: Four miniatures: an empty inbox, skeleton rows while loading, a panel that says OpenProject is not reachable while the mail still works, and a panel that asks you to sign in to OpenProject.

cap_MlSettings.text:
Capabilities: user-settings-dialog, linked-openproject-account, link-suggestions, default-project-rules, link-defaults, notification-bundling.
What you see: The settings dialog over the inbox, on the OpenProject section. It shows the linked instance, two switches, the rules that pick a project per folder or sender, and what happens when you link a mail.

cap_MlMobile.text:
Capabilities: phone-layout, work-package-chips, bottom-app-bar, link-bottom-sheet.
What you see: Three phone frames: the inbox, the Lyon conversation with its work package chip, and the bottom sheet Link to work package with a suggestion and a green Link button.

cap_MlLinkLifecycle.text:
Capabilities: link-lifecycle, link-on-reply, link-on-forward, link-on-move, link-on-delete, mailbox-access.
What you see: Six cards that say what a link does when you link, get a reply, forward, move or archive, delete the mail, or look without access. Each card ends with what the work package shows in OpenProject.

cap_MlThreadPanel.text:
Capabilities: work-package-panel, status-change-in-place, work-package-from-mail, unlink.
What you see: Level 2, act. Both rails folded; the work package panel for FEATURE #58412, in development and assigned to Tom Achterberg, open in a 360 px panel beside the reading pane. The chip in the subject bar is pressed and the X at the panel's top right closes it.

cap_MlFolding.text:
Capabilities: fold-in-levels, three-things-rule, navigation-rail, conversation-rail, hover-to-peek.
What you see: The three levels browse, read and act as column diagrams drawn to scale with their pixel widths, and the four rules: never more than three things side by side, how a rail opens and folds with the panel icon, how the X on a panel or on the subject bar returns you a level, that the work package opens from its chip.
